comments.body:
Situ, Longshou, please add a unit test and integration test for your updates.
And see code review comments.

Andrew Woods, I haven't add any new public methods, just changed the SPARQL to JQL, so the current unit test and integration test should be testing my changes too. Do you think those test cases are not enough for testing the OAIProvider? Or you just need me to write unit test for the private methods like "private String listResourceQuery(...)", "private RowIterator executeQuery(...)" etc that I refactored?
Can you send me a link to the existing tests that exercise your updates?

Sure.
Here are the test classes that are related to three functions I updated in the OAIProviderService:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/blob/master/src/test/java/org/fcrepo/oai/integration/ListIdentifiersIT.java
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/blob/master/src/test/java/org/fcrepo/oai/integration/ListRecordsIT.java
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/blob/master/src/test/java/org/fcrepo/oai/integration/ListSetsIT.java

Great. Thanks. No additional tests are required.
This ticket can be finished by just addressing the code review comments.
See PR https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/pull/9, commit https://github.com/lsitu/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/commit/ab3dc9566bba74f8ca8be37c21b25abcb9c1dd32.

renderedFields.description:
This task is to refactor the fcrepo4-oaiprovider project to no longer need any of the classes in the org.fcrepo.oai.jql package:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/tree/master/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/oai/jql

Where these classes are used (such as by: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/blob/master/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/oai/service/OAIProviderService.java) the SPARQL queries should be replaced by direct JQL queries.
